device: Tuna EMULATED HDR10 qualification sink; not physical hardware or a shipping kernel module
licensing: Upstream per-file SPDX GPL-2.0+ retained; Makefile GPL-2.0-only. Added driver/probe GPL-2.0+. Complete upstream GPL-2.0 and Linux-syscall-note retained with COPYING.
scope: Separate module/platform/DRM name tuna_hdr_vkms; stock vkms is never replaced or unloaded
Exact synthetic EDID explicitly names TUNA EMU HDR / TUNA EMU SDR
Real XR30 and AR30 ten-bit read and write conversions; no eight-bit truncation
HDR admission in kernel requires active ten-bit primary, BT2020_RGB, max requested bpc10 and PQ/type1 metadata

Root connected sysfs parameter models a real virtual cable; connector detect plus canonical single-connector HPD helper updates kernel connection status/epoch and emits actual DRM hotplug uevents; lifetime mutex prevents events against torn-down device
Unplug/replug keeps the same registered connector and exact EDID; no compositor state overrides; kernel mode/EDID cache clearing follows normal master reprobe
No fake compositor flags, capability overrides or policy relaxation
FBdev console registration removed so emulated qualification module does not take host consoles

runtime_recipe.headers: Exact running kernel headers, present in pinned official cloud image. Both generated UTS_RELEASE and include/config/kernel.release must equal the running kernel before external-module build; actual built module name/vermagic are checked immediately after build and again before load. No host kernel replacement or ABI override.
runtime_recipe.guest_prerequisite_coherence: Immutable official archive matching the authenticated image era, including Noble updates/security/backports. Noble APT normally uses By-Hash but can fall back to mutable index filenames even with force; snapshot paths remove that mirror-sync race. No acquisition retry, ignored update error, disabled signature/hash/Valid-Until check, kernel replacement, or relaxed ABI guard.

observed_live_archive_failure.sequence: Ign for noble-updates/main and universe Packages, then fallback to mutable http://archive.ubuntu.com/ubuntu/dists/noble-updates/main/binary-amd64/Packages.xz
observed_live_archive_failure.failure_stage: APT metadata acquisition; package installation and module build were not reached
observed_live_archive_failure.limit: The log demonstrates fallback and a mutable-index coherence failure, not the reason the initial by-hash request was unavailable. Snapshot signature acceptance, complete package installation and exact kernel/header/module closure require actual guest execution; source research alone is not qualification.

observed_header_abi_failure.sequence: Immutable signed 20261018T000000Z APT prerequisites installed successfully; the installer then rejected standalone make kernelrelease output 6.8.12 against actual running kernel 6.8.0-147-generic before module compilation.
observed_header_abi_failure.cause: Ubuntu's packaged Makefile VERSION/PATCHLEVEL/SUBLEVEL describe upstream base 6.8.12, not Ubuntu ABI 6.8.0-147-generic. Without M=, kernelrelease calls scripts/setlocalversion and recomputes that upstream base. External-module Kbuild instead reads the packaged include/config/kernel.release, while generated UTS_RELEASE supplies module vermagic.
observed_header_abi_failure.limit: The failed guest retained package identities and running kernel but not generated-header contents. Matching local packaged headers were researched read-only; their contents are not represented as direct guest evidence. The earlier reported localhost preflight and this failed guest preparation were not rerun to confirm them.

readonly_matching_packaged_header_eviden.scope: Read-only local Ubuntu 6.8.0-147.147 package/source inspection; not guest execution, compilation, load or HDR proof
readonly_matching_packaged_header_eviden..config: CONFIG_VERSION_SIGNATURE="Ubuntu 6.8.0-147.147-generic 6.8.12"; CONFIG_LOCALVERSION=""; CONFIG_LOCALVERSION_AUTO is not set

readonly_matching_packaged_header_eviden.packaged_makefile_authority: Makefile:2-5 sets upstream 6.8.12; :365-368 reads KERNELRELEASE from include/config/kernel.release separately from KERNELVERSION; :1187-1195 recomputes release for non-external builds; :1791-1800 preserves packaged KERNELRELEASE for external modules; :2059-2060 dispatches kernelrelease to the selected computation

runtime_recipe.guest_fixture_delta_receipts: Retained guest-artifacts.tar.gz contains apt/fixture-delta.json (original/effective sources and APT config, actual kernel), apt/packages-before.tsv, guest-packages.tsv after preparation even on failure, apt/*InRelease and apt/index-targets.txt. The installer now writes artifacts/kernel-headers.json before an ABI rejection: running/resolved header paths, bounded generated/config/Makefile identity lines and file hashes, plus native image/header package versions, source package versions and installed status. Existing endpoint/build receipts retain actual module/source identity and full built module vermagic; source authentication or header matching is not a runtime pass.
runtime_recipe.acceleration: KVM if accessible, otherwise explicitly recorded TCG; both execute actual guest kernel DRM ioctls
runtime_recipe.root_assertion: D-COLOR-HDR-KMS only after actual kernel selftest JSON/raw retention, command success, unsupported connector identity and isolated module/QEMU/disk/key cleanup; does not claim native compositor/capture qualification
runtime_recipe.native_capture_assertion: Separate payload-owned D-COLOR-HDR-CAPTURE; a default guest-command=true must not satisfy native capture qualification
runtime_recipe.clean_native_start: Module unloaded/reloaded between kernel selftest and native compositor; no stale selftest metadata/framebuffer can satisfy production output assertions

evidence_limits: No module compilation, module load, VM boot, tests or graphical qualification was executed by this ABI-repair worker. Read-only matching local headers distinguish the Ubuntu ABI from the upstream 6.8.12 base; both generated-header and packaged kernel.release equality guards are mandatory, and built module name/vermagic must still match the running kernel. Corrected guest receipts, actual module build/load, kernel selftest and native HDR/capture remain unobserved until parent verification and CI.
identity operation and property presence alone are not proof of HDR production output.

selftest proves real kernel XR30 pageflip/writeback/metadata and invalid-commit rejection; native compositor FP16 render, display configuration, screencast, restart and unsupported-output journeys must run separately inside the same endpoint.
snapshot reads actual active primary GEM, not composed writeback; kernel selftest separately proves the writeback path.

Live hotplug source/control/probe are implemented; actual native output/global/calibration removal, return and new-frame evidence must be observed in the pinned guest proof, not inferred from a sysfs write or fabricated unknown state.
Virtual HDR code values and metadata cannot qualify physical panel or link fidelity. Physical qualification is outside EMULATED device claims.
